description: Port the GenOffice shell app VERBATIM into redrob-office/apps/shell. The shell is the unified window that hosts each editor as a WebContentsView child and imports each app's main-process entry (createDocsView, createSheetsView, etc.). Bringing it in first establishes the host that later editor apps plug into. At this stage the shell references editor apps that are not yet copied, so wire it to build against the ones present and land the remaining editor apps in FEAT-004..FEAT-007; keep the shell compiling by porting its full source now and letting the app imports resolve as each editor app arrives.
steps: Copy /projects/sandbox/_refs/genoffice/apps/shell verbatim into /projects/sandbox/redrob-office/apps/shell, preserving src/main (index.ts, tab-manager.ts, updater, cloud-projects, pdf2docx-local, etc.), src/preload, src/renderer (Home, TabBar, AppFrame, SettingsModal, Onboarding, strings, etc.), src/shared, tests/, electron.vite.config.ts, electron-builder config, build/ icons, and package.json (@genoffice/shell).

Because the shell's tab-manager.ts imports sibling app main modules by relative path (../../../docs/src/main/docs-main, ../../../sheets/src/main/sheets-main, ../../../slides/src/main/slides-main, ../../../pdf/src/main/pdf-main, ../../../markdown/src/main/markdown-main), those apps must exist for the shell to typecheck/build. To keep this feature self-contained, port the docs app together with the shell in this feature (docs is the first editor and the default build target), OR sequence so FEAT-004 lands docs before verifying shell build. Implementer note: copy apps/docs verbatim here alongside the shell so the shell has at least one real editor to host; the remaining editors follow in FEAT-005..FEAT-007.

Copy apps/docs verbatim from /projects/sandbox/_refs/genoffice/apps/docs into apps/docs (src/main docs-main.ts/atomic-write/docx-encryption/external-change/updater/index, src/renderer App.tsx + ai/* + assets + full editor UI, src/shared ipc, tests/ including pagination-corpus and encrypted-fixtures, electron.vite.config.ts, scripts/, package.json @genoffice/docs).
Run `pnpm install` to link @genoffice/shell and @genoffice/docs and their deps (electron 43, react 19, electron-vite, officecrypto-tool, etc.).

Port the GenOffice predev/preload tooling the shell/docs builds need (tools/build-stale-preloads.mjs) and confirm electron-vite config paths resolve inside the merged repo. Adjust ONLY workspace-relative path/config wiring, never editor logic.

Build and typecheck the shell + docs: run their electron-vite build and `tsc --noEmit` (via pnpm --filter). The shell's imports of sheets/slides/pdf/markdown mains will not resolve yet - handle by either (a) temporarily guarding those imports behind the not-yet-ported apps with a clearly-marked TODO that FEAT-005..007 remove, or (b) porting stub-free by ensuring tab-manager only wires the apps present. Prefer approach that keeps original code intact and re-enables each import as its app lands; document the exact lines touched so later features restore them.
acceptance_criteria: apps/shell and apps/docs contain the original GenOffice source (main + renderer + shared + tests) with package.json names @genoffice/shell and @genoffice/docs.
`pnpm install` links both apps with exit 0.
The docs app typechecks and its ported vitest suite runs (docx round-trip/pagination tests present).

The shell typechecks/builds with the editors present; any temporarily-guarded imports for not-yet-ported apps are explicitly marked with TODO(FEAT-00X) so they are restored, not left as permanent stubs.
Root `pnpm typecheck` still passes for the existing @redrob workspace (no regression).
verification: `pnpm --filter '@genoffice/docs' build` and `pnpm --filter '@genoffice/shell' build` complete (with documented guarded imports for pending apps)
`pnpm typecheck` at root passes for existing packages

- apps/shell  <- /projects/sandbox/_refs/genoffice/apps/shell  (package name @genoffice/shell). Full src/main (index.ts, tab-manager.ts, updater, cloud-projects, pdf2docx-local/pdf2pptx-local/pdf2xlsx-local, recent-files, star-prompt, analytics, app-settings, dropped-files, error-dialog, pdf-password-dialog, update-window), src/preload (index/update/pdf-password), src/renderer (Home, TabBar, AppFrame, SettingsModal, Onboarding, StarPromptCard, strings, locale, provider-logos, css, assets incl genoffice-logo.svg), src/shared (home-api/tabs-api/update-api/pdf-password-api), tests/ (+ fixtures pdfs), electron.vite.config.ts, electron-builder.cjs, build/ icons.

AI-PROVIDER PLACEHOLDER (TODO(FEAT-007)) - packages/ai-provider:
The shell (src/preload/index.ts, renderer SettingsModal/provider-logos, shared/home-api) and docs (src/main/docs-main.ts, src/shared/ipc.ts) import @genoffice/ai-provider, which was intentionally NOT ported (rejected BYOK layer; Redrob engine replaces it in FEAT-007). Per the briefing I created a temporary local placeholder package @genoffice/ai-provider exposing the SAME TypeScript surface as index.ts exported, so shell+docs typecheck and build without shipping BYOK network clients:
- COPIED VERBATIM (pure, no network, no keys): src/types.ts, src/providers.ts (provider metadata + settings resolution), src/registry.ts (endpoint resolution), src/watchdog.ts (timeouts), src/network-error.ts, src/overload-error.ts, src/fetch.ts (rescue-fetch injector), src/protocols/shared.ts (SSE line splitter + AiCreditsError), src/index.ts (unchanged export surface).
- registry.ts EDIT (TODO(FEAT-007)): removed the two imports from ./protocols/anthropic and ./protocols/gemini (the BYOK protocol clients, deliberately not copied) and inlined the two default base-URL string constants (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, GEMINI_BASE_URL) they provided. Endpoint resolution is otherwise byte-identical.
- STUBBED (TODO(FEAT-007), throwing/erroring, preserve signatures): src/chat.ts `chatForProvider` returns { ok:false, error } and src/stream.ts `streamForProvider` throws - both explain the Redrob layer lands in FEAT-007. The BYOK protocol clients (protocols/anthropic.ts, protocols/gemini.ts, protocols/openai-compatible.ts) are NOT shipped, so no third-party BYOK provider code enters the product.
- package.json name @genoffice/ai-provider, dep @genoffice/agent-core workspace:*, tsconfig extends ../../tsconfig.genoffice.base.json. No tests.

TAB-MANAGER / SHELL SIBLING WIRING (not-yet-ported apps): the shell's src/main/index.ts (~4266 lines, ~1235 references) and tab-manager.ts import sibling app mains by RELATIVE PATH for sheets/slides/pdf/markdown, which are ported in FEAT-004 (sheets) and FEAT-005 (slides/pdf/markdown). Commenting out ~1235 in-file usage sites would gut the shell's verbatim source, so instead I kept the shell source 100% UNTOUCHED and added TEMPORARY placeholder sibling MODULES at the exact relative paths the shell imports. Each placeholder re-declares only the exact export surface the shell consumes, with a header TODO(FEAT-004)/TODO(FEAT-005) instructing that feature to REPLACE the file with the verbatim GenOffice app. Runtime bodies throw (loud) or return a safe default (e.g. *IsDirty -> false, *PendingEditCount -> 0). - apps/sheets/src/main/sheets-main.ts, apps/sheets/src/gateway/csv-import.ts (TODO(FEAT-004))
- apps/slides/src/main/slides-main.ts, apps/slides/src/main/env.d.ts (env.d.ts COPIED VERBATIM - pure ambient module decls; referenced by shell tsconfig include) (TODO(FEAT-005))
- apps/pdf/src/main/pdf-main.ts, apps/pdf/src/main/blank-pdf.ts, apps/pdf/src/main/wasm-path.ts, apps/pdf/src/shared/ipc.ts (ipc.ts COPIED VERBATIM - PDF_CHANNELS constant + shared IPC types the shell reads; FEAT-005's verbatim pdf copy will match it) (TODO(FEAT-005))
- apps/markdown/src/main/markdown-main.ts (TODO(FEAT-005))
These four placeholder app dirs have NO package.json, so pnpm does not treat them as workspaces; FEAT-004/FEAT-005 overwrite them with the real verbatim apps.

WIRING FIXES (workspace/module-resolution/config only, NO editor logic changed):
1) package.json internal deps rewritten from bare "*" (npm-workspaces) to "workspace:*" (pnpm) in apps/docs and apps/shell (same as FEAT-002 convention).
2) apps/shell/package.json: removed the @genoffice/sheets and @genoffice/slides devDeps (their apps are not ported yet; FEAT-004/FEAT-005 restore them). Added @genoffice/project-store (workspace:* - imported by src/main/index.ts, undeclared upstream via flat hoist). Added a dependencies block: `undici` ^6.28.0 (dynamic import in index.ts for ProxyAgent; GenOffice resolved undici 6.28.0 via flat hoist) and `@embedpdf/pdfium` ^2.15.0 (imported by src/main/pdf2docx-local.ts; GenOffice's pdf app/pdf2docx declare ^2.15.0). Both are runtime deps of the shell's own pdf2docx-local code.
3) apps/docs/package.json: added devDep `jszip` ^3.10.1 (used by many docs tests via `import JSZip from 'jszip'`; GenOffice resolved 3.10.1 via flat hoist, undeclared in the docs app).
4) tsconfig extends: apps/docs/tsconfig.json and apps/shell/tsconfig.json now extend ../../tsconfig.genoffice.base.json (moduleResolution bundler) instead of ../../tsconfig.base.json (NodeNext), matching FEAT-002.
5) @genoffice/ui path re-point: FEAT-002 copied GenOffice's packages/ui to packages/genoffice-ui (dir renamed to coexist with @redrob/ui; package name still @genoffice/ui). Repointed the `@genoffice/ui` path alias from ../../packages/ui/src/index.ts to ../../packages/genoffice-ui/src/index.ts in apps/docs/tsconfig.json, apps/docs/vitest.config.ts, and apps/shell/tsconfig.json. Also fixed ONE deep-relative test import in apps/docs/tests/shape-gallery.test.ts (was ../../../packages/ui/src/shape-gallery -> ../../../packages/genoffice-ui/src/shape-gallery) - forced by the FEAT-002 dir rename, not a logic change (commented inline).

CROSS-FEATURE FIXES needed for the shell to typecheck/build (documented so they are understood, not silent):
A) packages/electron-utils/package.json: FEAT-002 had pinned its electron devDep to ^35.5.1 (the office app's version). The ported docs/shell apps use electron ^43.3.0, and the shell's tsconfig maps @genoffice/electron-utils to its source, so electron-utils' electron 35 types leaked into the shell program and rejected Electron 43's `type: 'header'` menu items. GenOffice's electron-utils declares NO electron (single hoisted electron 43.3.0 upstream). Aligned electron-utils' devDep to ^43.3.0 so all @genoffice packages/apps share one electron major (43), matching upstream. The @redrob/office app keeps its own isolated electron 35.
B) Root package.json pnpm.overrides: added "prosemirror-view": "1.42.1". A fresh pnpm install floated the docs app's @tiptap 3.x tree to prosemirror-view 1.42.3, which has a DecorationGroup.locals regression (crashes 4 native-table tests with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading localsInner)'). GenOffice's committed lockfile resolved prosemirror-view 1.42.1; pinning to it restores the verbatim tests to green. Verified this does not regress @redrob/office (its tiptap 2.x is compatible with 1.42.1).
C) Root .npmrc: added `hoist-pattern[]=*`, `hoist-pattern[]=!@types/react`, `hoist-pattern[]=!@types/react-dom`. redrob-office now runs two React majors: @redrob/office is React 18 while the ported @genoffice apps are React 19. pnpm's default virtual-store hoist put the highest @types/react (19.2.18) into .pnpm/node_modules, where @tiptap/react's bundled .d.ts resolves it - so the office (React 18) typecheck saw React 19's ReactNode (which now includes bigint) and failed on EditorContent (this reproduced even with all FEAT-003 files removed - a latent FEAT-002 issue surfaced by the @types/react@19.2.14->19.2.18 patch float). Excluding @types/react* from the hoist forces every consumer to resolve @types/react from its own peer set (18 for office, 19 for the @genoffice apps), isolating the two majors. (The install after this change required `pnpm install --config.confirmModulesPurge=false` because pnpm rebuilds node_modules from scratch when the hoist pattern changes.)

TOOLING: tools/build-stale-preloads.mjs already present from FEAT-002 (not clobbered). No other tooling was needed for the shell/docs builds.
